description_en: Queries face data by face name
description_zh: 通过人脸名称查找人脸数据
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-face-user-by-name --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --name Tony --params key1_:_value1_,_key2_:_value2 --page-size 10 --page-no 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryFaceUserByName

parameters.help_en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value as the **IsolationId** specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html operation to add a user
parameters.help_zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html接口添加用户时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致
parameters.name: isolation_id

parameters.help_en:
The username. The username can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and Chinese characters, and can be up to 64 characters in length.

Fuzzy match is supported. If you leave this parameter empty, all records are matched
parameters.help_zh:
用户名。支持中文、英文字母大小写、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过64个字符。

支持模糊匹配，若不填，则为全量匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The custom user parameter.

Exact match is supported, but fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
用户参数，请自定义。

支持匹配搜索，但不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: params

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中，每页显示的记录数量。最大取值50，最小取值1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: page_no
